name: Yurina
source:
"Nuigurumers are everyone's friends. They are not tools"

A naive and childish girl who would never cast doubt on others. Yurina was abandoned in front of an old couple's house when she was a baby. She was shocked to see the modified Kigurumers and decided to fight alongside Hero and his group.

She possesses a strange ability that lets her understand Kigurumers' feelings...
